business_scope.primary_industry_name: Vertical Industrial ERP and Customer Relationship Software

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Marshall Islands (Unitary jurisdiction, capital Majuro; constitutional Compact of Free Association with the United States)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law and United States statutory influences, blended with local RMI statutes and customary law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the United States and the Republic of the Marshall Islands (1986; Amended Compact 2003)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement between the United States and the Marshall Islands (2003)
Trade and Investment Framework Agreement with the United States (2003)
Agreement Establishing the World Trade Organization (accession effective 24 December 2020)
Pacific Island Countries Trade Agreement (PICTA) framework

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Republic of the Marshall Islands Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (AML/CFT) Act 2012, as amended by the AML/CFT Amendment Act 2018, administered by the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit; Business Corporations Act 1990 (Title 27, RMI Revised Code 1990, as amended); Non-Resident Domestic Corporations Act 2019 (effective 1 January 2020); Registered Agents Act 2017 (licensed agent obligations to obtain and maintain beneficial ownership records); FIU Beneficial Ownership Guidance applying a 25% equity/control threshold

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copy of the beneficial owner's valid passport
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent passport-issuing authority of the beneficial owner's country of nationality

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or Certificate of Good Standing of any corporate founding shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or licensed registered agent of the founding entity's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter covering the source of funds of the founder and initial contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Source financial institution holding the founder's account

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the RMI-licensed registered agent as statutory agent for service of process
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Directors and shareholders of MH_BC executed before a notary public

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory automated and manual screening of all directors, shareholders, and beneficial owners against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN and Non-SDN Lists, UK HM Treasury consolidated sanctions list, and RMI FIU domestic advisories; FATF-aligned definition of Politically Exposed Persons applied to domestic and foreign PEPs, immediate family members, and close associates; enhanced due diligence and source-of-funds verification required upon any PEP match or high-risk jurisdiction indicator; screening and UBO records retained for a minimum of five (5) years following termination of the business relationship; the target entity is classified as Low_Risk_Standard for software/cloud services with no statutory licensing requirement

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Register of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands, administered by the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Resources and Development, Majuro Atoll; filings and name reservations are effected exclusively through RMI-licensed registered agents, as no automated public e-portal is maintained
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in the English/Latin alphabet, which is the statutory administrative script; the RMI imposes no local-script transliteration obligation; names may contain Arabic numerals and must include a recognized corporate suffix, namely Corporation, Company, Incorporated, Limited, Societe Anonyme, or the abbreviations Corp., Co., Inc., Ltd., or S.A.; the proposed name must be distinguishable upon the register from all existing and reserved names
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant's licensed registered agent may (i) request a single 30-day extension of the name reservation by payment of the statutory extension fee, or (ii) file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of Corporations within 14 calendar days of the rejection, specifying grounds of distinguishability; if the Registrar affirms the refusal, the applicant may appeal to the Minister of Resources and Development, and thereafter to the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands under the Business Corporations Act; alternatively, the applicant may obtain and file the written consent of the holder of the conflicting name to overcome the rejection

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for the Vertical Industrial ERP and CRM cloud software model; the statutory registered office of MH_BC must be the physical premises of the licensed registered agent in the Republic of the Marshall Islands; there is no requirement for local staff, physical servers, or local business premises, and operations may be conducted entirely remotely through the target payment rails of Stripe Billing and Direct Debit
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low; estimated probability of 5-10% of an unannounced physical or statutory inspection within the first three years for an entity classified as Low_Risk_Standard; inspections are risk-based and typically triggered by adverse indicators such as sanctions matches, PEP exposure, or suspicious transaction reports; the registered agent must produce the UBO register and KYC files on demand

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the Business Corporations Act 1990 fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for standard-risk non-resident software entities

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: KYC, UBO piercing, PEP and OFAC/UN sanctions screening onboarding package

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee under the Non-Resident Domestic Corporations Act 2019

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended), Title 5 of the Marshall Islands Revised Statutes; Sections 9 (Articles of Incorporation), 11 (Registered Office and Registered Agent), 18 (Consideration for Shares), 27 (Directors), 42 (Action by Written Consent), and 107 (Non-Resident Domestic Corporation).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Corporations Division, Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands (filings effected through an accredited registered agent).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation filed under Section 9 of the Business Corporations Act; issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation by the Registrar of Corporations.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. The Business Corporation may be incorporated with zero paid-in capital; authorized share capital determines only the annual government franchise tax, not a deposit requirement. No escrow account or bank confirmation is required under Marshall Islands law; consideration for issued shares may be cash, promissory notes, or services rendered.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Bylaws submitted to the directors are adopted as the Bylaws of the Corporation; RESOLVED, that the registered office located at the registered agent's address in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and the appointment of the registered agent named in the Articles of Incorporation are ratified; RESOLVED, that the subscriptions to common shares set forth in the subscription statements are accepted, and the officers are directed to issue and allot such shares upon receipt of lawful consideration; RESOLVED, that the Corporation elects status as a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation to the fullest extent permitted by law; RESOLVED, that the President, Secretary, and Treasurer are appointed to serve until successors are duly elected; RESOLVED, that the officers are authorized to execute banking agreements, cloud services contracts, and all filings required under Marshall Islands law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Corporations Division, Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro (submitted via accredited registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the registered agent to perform a name availability search against the official corporate index. The proposed name must end with 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', or an approved abbreviation, and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing domestic or foreign registered entity. Submit the Name Reservation Application and pay the search/reservation fee. A 30-day reservation period is automatically granted.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or prohibited wording, select an alternative name from the secondary list and re-file the reservation; no appeal is required, and the resubmission is processed within one business day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (preparation by counsel; execution by incorporator/subscriber)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation under Section 9 of the Business Corporations Act, stating the corporate name, registered office address in Majuro, registered agent name and address, authorized share structure (e.g., 50,000 common shares at USD 1.00 par value), initial directors, and any permitted limitations on business purposes. The incorporator must sign the Articles; if the incorporator is outside the Marshall Islands, the signature must be witnessed and notarized, with an apostille obtained from the competent authority of the signatory's jurisdiction.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a deficiency notice, cure by filing a Supplementary Statement or corrected Articles within 30 days of the notice; late cure is treated as a new filing and assessed a fresh fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Articles and Payment of Government Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Corporations Division, Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Transmit the executed Articles of Incorporation and the USD 500 state filing fee through the registered agent to the Registrar. The fee is payable by wire transfer, certified check, or agent escrow account. The Registrar stamps the Articles with the date and time of filing and issues the Certificate of Incorporation, which evidences the legal existence of the Business Corporation. Expedited filing (24-hour service) is available for an additional statutory fee.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If filing is rejected, correct the stated deficiency and re-file with the Registrar within 14 days; expedited re-filing is available for same-day or 24-hour issuance upon payment of the expedite fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Designation of Registered Office and Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Ensure the registered office is a physical street address in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and that the registered agent is either a natural person resident in the Marshall Islands or a licensed corporate services provider. The agent's written consent must be filed with the Registrar. The registered office is the legal address for service of process and official notices.
required_dossiers: Consent to Act as Registered Agent
Letter of authorization for the registered office premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent's license lapses or the address is non-compliant, the Corporation must appoint a substitute agent and file a Change of Registered Agent and/or Registered Office form within 30 days to avoid administrative dissolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board of Directors Written Consent and Organizational Actions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors (acting by unanimous written consent under Section 42 of the Business Corporations Act)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a unanimous written consent of the initial directors in lieu of a physical meeting. The consent shall adopt the corporate Bylaws, ratify the registered office and agent, accept share subscriptions, approve the issuance of shares, appoint the President, Secretary, and Treasurer, adopt the corporate seal, and authorize the opening of bank accounts and execution of the vertical ERP/CRM cloud platform subscription agreements. All consents must be signed by each director and placed in the corporate records book.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any director dissents or a consent signature is defective, promptly convene a duly noticed special board meeting and adopt the same resolutions by majority vote; minutes of that meeting cure the procedural defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Certificates and Good Standing Evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a certified true copy of the Certificate of Incorporation, a certified copy of the Articles of Incorporation, and a Certificate of Good Standing (Status Certificate) from the Registrar. If the certificate is required for bank onboarding or foreign counterparties, have the certificate apostilled by the Marshall Islands Attorney General's Office or the competent treaty authority.
required_dossiers: Application for Certificate of Good Standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the issued certificate contains erroneous entity data, file a Request for Administrative Correction with the Registrar and provide supporting evidence; corrected certificates are reissued within five business days without additional state fee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — ISIC 6201 (vertical ERP/CRM cloud software) is not a statutorily licensed industrial activity in the Marshall Islands. No industrial or manufacturing operations are conducted. If a physical office is later opened in Majuro, the Majuro Local Government in coordination with the RMI Ministry of Finance Business License Section would govern a local business license.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Exempt — Non-Resident Domestic Corporation status under Section 107 of the Business Corporations Act; no sectoral operating permit, manufacturing license, or investment license is required for offshore software-as-a-service operations.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA) of the Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category 'Clean Services / Office and Cloud Software Operations' under the EPA permit regulations; no Environmental Impact Assessment or environmental permit is required for the stated business scope.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for cloud software activities: zero wastewater discharge, zero VOC emissions, and no hazardous waste generation are produced on site. For any administrative office, comply with Majuro sewerage connection standards, general solid waste collection rules under the RMI Solid Waste Management Regulations, and the Hazardous Substances (Management) Act regarding disposal of e-waste and spent batteries.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not required for an offshore non-resident corporation without physical premises. If a Majuro office is established, obtain a Fire Safety Inspection Certificate from the RMI National Fire Service, a structural load/occupancy clearance from the Majuro building inspector, and a workplace health and safety clearance under applicable RMI occupational safety regulations before commencing local operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue Administration, Ministry of Finance, Planning and Commercial Affairs, Republic of the Marshall Islands (income tax administration); Office of the Registrar of Corporations (corporate registry and formation, administered through licensed Marshall Islands registered agents). No comprehensive tax e-portal exists; statutory income tax filings are submitted on prescribed forms to the Revenue Administration in Majuro, while corporate formation filings are submitted electronically by licensed registered agents.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the Business Corporation under the Business Corporations Act 1991 through a licensed registered agent (name availability check, filing of Articles of Incorporation, payment of charter fee); no statutory TIN is issued at formation. Step 2: If the entity derives Marshall Islands-source income, file an income tax registration application with the Revenue Administration within the statutory period and obtain a TIN. Step 3: If the entity employs personnel in the Republic, register simultaneously with the Marshall Islands Social Security Administration. Step 4: A purely non-resident Business Corporation with zero Marshall Islands-source income is not required to hold a TIN or file income tax returns; it must maintain its registered agent and comply with annual corporate franchise/permit requirements. Step 5: No indirect tax registration is possible or required because the Republic imposes no VAT, GST, or general sales tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or comparable pass-through election exists under Marshall Islands law; entity classification is statutory. The Income Tax Act 1989 permits affiliated resident corporations to elect consolidated group filing, and a non-resident corporation with a permanent establishment in the Republic may elect to be taxed as a resident on Marshall Islands-source income. The Republic has not adopted BEPS Action 2 hybrid-mismatch rules, so no hybrid mismatch elections are available; no tax treaty elections exist because the Republic maintains no comprehensive double tax treaties.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no indirect tax registration regime or economic turnover threshold exists. Functional currency: United States Dollar (USD).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. The Marshall Islands imposes no real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing clearinghouse, tax administration API integration, digital stamping, or invoice clearance obligation on software or cloud service providers; invoicing is governed by general commercial law only.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — the Republic of the Marshall Islands levies no VAT, GST, or sales-and-use tax; consequently, there is no export zero-rating mechanism and no input VAT refund regime to claim. Vertical ERP/CRM cloud software is an intangible service delivered remotely; as a non-resident Business Corporation deriving no Marshall Islands-source income, the entity remains outside the territorial income tax base and requires no zero-rated export documentation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Not applicable — cloud-delivered ERP/CRM software is an intangible cross-border service involving no physical export; no Marshall Islands Customs export declaration, bill of lading, inward remittance certificate, or VAT zero-rating certificate is required.

Contingency — if physical goods were exported from the Republic, the Marshall Islands Customs Service would require a formal Export Entry under the Customs Act, commercial invoice, and transport documentation; no VAT-related certificate exists.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No export zero-rating or VAT refund regime exists, so no indirect-tax clawback or refund-reversal exposure applies. General anti-avoidance authority under the Income Tax Act 1989 permits the Revenue Administrator to disregard artificial transactions designed to create or preserve non-resident exemption; failure to register, file, or provide information attracts penalties of up to USD 1,000 per offence, and false or fraudulent declarations may result in criminal fines and/or imprisonment. The Republic maintains no exchange controls, and with the USD as domestic currency, no FX repatriation compliance timeline or clawback deadline exists.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: N/A – No central bank exists in the Republic of the Marshall Islands; the US dollar is the sole legal tender. Banking supervision is performed by the Banking Commissioner under the Ministry of Finance, pursuant to the Banking Act 1991.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility for both capital and current account transactions because the Marshall Islands does not issue an independent currency and does not operate foreign exchange controls. Profit remittance and capital repatriation encounter no exchange-control hurdles but must comply with corporate filing, tax registration, and anti-money laundering verification obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender requirement exists. Export receipts may be held, converted, or remitted freely in US dollars; only standard record-keeping and AML reporting thresholds apply.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. The Marshall Islands has no fintech EMI or electronic money institution licensing framework; offshore digital EMIs cannot obtain a local licence and may only facilitate payments through a licensed local bank or a correspondent arrangement. Practical viability is conditional on banking-as-a-service integration with Bank of Marshall Islands or Bank of Guam and on satisfying both US OFAC and local AML requirements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is normally not mandated for all directors, but at least one signatory officer is typically expected to complete an in-person or verified video KYC interview with the compliance officer. Remote account opening is possible using apostilled corporate documents, notarized board resolutions, and certified passport copies, subject to final bank approval.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident business corporation with undisclosed beneficial owners or complex ownership chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current certificate of good standing, full register of directors and shareholders, apostilled certificate of incorporation, audited or management accounts, beneficial ownership declaration, sanctions screening report, and notarized board resolutions identifying account signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Low minimum capital and 'Tax_Exempt_Zone' classification treated as potential shell-company indicator
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan, executed SaaS/ERP commercial contracts, invoice trail, website and product documentation, proof of operational substance (employees or third-party service providers), bank statements from other jurisdictions, and a sworn source-of-funds affidavit for initial deposits.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital transfers from high-risk or unregulated fintech intermediaries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed wire-transfer instruction forms, correspondent bank reference, purpose-of-payment statements, KYC/KYB documentation of the remitter, proof of underlying trade or investment transaction, and board-approved capital contribution resolution.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital is routed via SWIFT USD wire transfers to the resident USD account at a licensed Marshall Islands bank. Each transfer must include the corporate legal name, account number, a clear purpose code such as 'capital subscription', 'paid-in capital contribution', or 'business operating expenses', and supporting board resolution and certificate of incorporation. For proceeds above USD 10,000, banks apply enhanced due diligence and source-of-funds verification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Permissible clearing rails include SWIFT MT103 single customer credit transfers, SWIFT MT202 for interbank beneficiary transfers, commercial letters of credit (documentary credits), and direct debits via the local automated clearing facility, when available, or via correspondent banking through Bank of Guam or the US Federal Reserve network. All outbound payments require beneficiary KYC, underlying invoice or contract evidence, and compliance with economic-sanctions screening.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Offshore US dollar–foreign currency FX forwards through licensed international banks (non-deliverable, settled in USD)
Cross-currency swaps executed with a US or foreign banking counterparty for material multi-currency trade exposures
Plain-vanilla currency options and FX swaps permitted only where the local Marshall Islands bank offers a correspondent hedging line

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report and Franchise Tax Payment (Combined Annual Return Form)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands, via the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of incorporation; the filing and payment must be completed and remitted by the last business day of the anniversary month to avoid late fees.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 10% of the annual franchise tax immediately after the due date, increasing to 20% after 60 days; continued non-payment for 6 months permits the Registrar to begin administrative revocation proceedings, and strike-off generally occurs after 12 months of continued delinquency.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation of Statutory Registers, Beneficial Ownership File and Registered Agent Details
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations (maintained by the licensed registered agent at the registered office; no separate public UBO registry filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same anniversary due date as the Annual Report; any share transfers completed in the preceding year must be updated in the share ledger before the confirmation is signed.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: False or incomplete confirmation is an offence under the Business Corporations Act and may expose the corporation and directors to a fine; unresolved discrepancies give the Registrar power to issue a compliance directive, and continued non-remediation supports administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory independent audit applies to a private non-resident Business Corporation unless a shareholder or group holding at least 10% of voting shares demands an audit; audit is otherwise required only for listed entities or entities holding a regulated banking, insurance, trust, or financial license.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The Marshall Islands prescribes no domestic GAAP for non-resident entities; IFRS or US GAAP is the accepted framework for the statutory accounting records and any voluntary or shareholder-demanded audit, with USD as the primary reporting currency.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The RMI does not require a separate public UBO return; the registered agent must maintain the beneficial ownership file at the registered office, and the annual confirmation records all shareholding transfers executed during the year. The directors sign the annual report confirming that the share ledger and UBO file are current and identify any controller changes since the last confirmation.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Member and Director Meetings
Register of Mortgages and Charges (if any encumbrances exist)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$800 – US$1,600 per annum for licensed registered agent, registered office, and standard corporate secretarial administration.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: No statutory audit cost is mandatory; a voluntary or shareholder-demanded IFRS/US GAAP audit of the non-resident BC typically ranges from US$5,000 to US$12,000 for a vertical SaaS/CRM holding entity, depending on transaction volume and intercompany balances.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Non-resident domestic corporations deriving income from sources outside the Republic of the Marshall Islands are wholly outside RMI income tax. No corporate income tax, branch profits tax, franchise tax, or capital duty applies to the foreign-source business. The only recurring sovereign charge is the annual registration fee payable to the Registrar of Corporations. This is not a tax holiday but a unilateral source-based exemption.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No RMI corporate income tax return is prescribed for a non-resident domestic corporation with no RMI-source income. If an RMI taxable nexus is inadvertently created, the entity becomes subject to the Income Tax Act and must file through the Treasury Tax and Revenue Administration (TTRA).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual only if an RMI-source trade or business arises; otherwise no income tax return is required.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No statutory deadline applies to a zero-liability non-resident BC. If an RMI-source business arises, the return deadline is the date prescribed by the Income Tax Act for the relevant fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: No income tax return fields are completed by an exempt non-resident domestic corporation because no taxable income exists under Marshall Islands source rules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain the entity strictly non-resident: no physical office, no employees, no local premises, and no RMI-source revenue. The only filing obligation is the annual corporate registration report to the Registrar.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late or non-filing of an income tax return is not penalized where no return is due. If an RMI-source obligation arises, failure to file attracts civil penalties, interest, and possible criminal prosecution for wilful non-compliance. Separate late annual report filing with the Registrar results in reinstatement fees and potential administrative dissolution.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable. The Republic of the Marshall Islands has not entered into any comprehensive double taxation agreement. No RMI withholding tax is imposed on dividends, so no DTA relief, Tax Residence Certificate, or treaty claim form is required at the RMI level. Foreign shareholders must rely exclusively on residence-country foreign tax credit rules.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding rate is 0% for both royalty and interest payments originating from a Marshall Islands non-resident domestic corporation. No treaty rates apply due to the absence of comprehensive tax treaties.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None. The Marshall Islands has no statutory transfer pricing documentation regime, and no Local File or Master File is required for an RMI non-resident BC. The only relevant documentation requirements arise under foreign tax systems in the shareholder or user jurisdiction.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI has adopted Economic Substance Regulations applicable to registered entities carrying on relevant activities: banking, insurance, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, shipping, holding entity, distribution and service centre, and intellectual property business. A vertical ERP/CRM cloud business may fall within the distribution/service or IP holding category if the RMI entity holds exploitable software intangibles or performs distribution functions. Entities in scope must satisfy a RMI-based management, expenditure, employees, and physical presence test and file an annual economic substance declaration. Penalties apply for non-compliance and false declarations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Wilfully understating RMI-source income, filing false information with the TTRA, or using the RMI entity as a sham conduit to conceal foreign tax evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Assessment of unpaid tax plus interest and penalties; criminal conviction carries imprisonment up to 5 years and fines up to USD 10,000 under the Marshall Islands Income Tax Act and criminal law.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who knowingly cause the misrepresentation are subject to civil restitution and criminal liability. Courts may pierce the corporate veil on proof of fraud, making controlling persons personally liable and subject to asset freezing orders and travel restrictions imposed as bail or court conditions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining an RMI-registered BC with no office, no local employees, no financial records, and no real operations while conducting the cloud business through the entity; filing an economic substance declaration that falsely certifies substantive presence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalties under the RMI Economic Substance Regulations per year of non-compliance, cancellation of registration, and referral to the Registrar for strike-off; false declarations may constitute an offence punishable by fine and imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who execute false declarations may be fined and disqualified from acting as directors. Piercing is available where the shell is used to defeat creditor or tax claims, exposing directors and members to personal liability for dissipated assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain an accurate beneficial ownership register, failing to appoint a money laundering reporting officer, or processing Stripe Billing and Direct Debit payments without customer due diligence or suspicious transaction reporting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil penalties per violation under RMI anti-money laundering legislation, regulatory orders, freezing orders, and criminal liability for knowing facilitation of money laundering or terrorist financing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Senior officers and directors may be prosecuted individually for wilful AML/CFT failures; they may be banned from corporate office, fined, imprisoned, and subjected to court-imposed travel bans and asset freezes pending proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed Financial Activity / Payment Regulatory Contravention
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Engaging in money transmission, custodial wallet services, or payment processing as principal without an RMI banking or money services licence while embedding Stripe Billing or Direct Debit rails into the vertical cloud.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Unlicensed financial business is legally unenforceable; regulators may issue cease-and-desist orders, impose monetary penalties, and require either registration as a money services business or documented reliance on a licensed payment processor.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally liable for debts and losses arising from unauthorized financial business, and may face regulatory disqualification, personal fines, and civil claims by injured counterparties.
